planting.note: Set out rooted cuttings after all frost danger in fertile, well-drained soil; this cooler-growing Andean species tolerates light frost dieback better than most Brugmansia and rebounds from the roots.

directions: Brugmansia arborea is a high-elevation Andean species that grows more compactly and holds its smaller, narrower white trumpets in a more upright fashion than its lowland relatives, making it useful where a tidier angel's trumpet is wanted. Give it afternoon shade in hot Gulf Coast summers, since it performs best where nights stay cooler, and keep the soil consistently moist with regular feeding to sustain bloom. Where winters dip below freezing it usually dies back but resprouts reliably from the root crown if mulched heavily. All parts of the plant are toxic if ingested; site away from children and pets and wash hands after pruning.

planting.note: Set out rooted cuttings after frost in rich, well-drained soil in partial shade to full sun; feed heavily to fuel the semi-double blooms.

directions: 'Dr. Seuss' produces semi-double, creamy white pendant trumpets accented with distinct green veining that runs down each petal and into the throat, a striking departure from the solid-color blooms of most angel's trumpets. It shares the genus's heavy evening fragrance and near-continuous warm-season flowering when kept well fed and consistently moist. In zone 9 protect from hard freezes by mulching heavily or overwintering container specimens indoors, since it has no cold tolerance. All parts of the plant are toxic if ingested; keep away from children and pets and wash hands after handling.
sources: North Carolina State Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox

planting.note: Set out rooted cuttings after frost in fertile, well-drained soil; site in partial shade in hot climates to protect the long, ribbon-like petals from scorching.

directions: 'Culebra', Spanish for snake, is named for its unusual corolla, whose lobes narrow into long, twisting, ribbon-like tips rather than the broad flared trumpet typical of the genus, giving each white flower a spidery, sculptural look. It carries the same intense evening fragrance and vigorous, fast-growing habit as other angel's trumpets, and responds well to regular feeding and consistent moisture. Protect from freezing temperatures by mulching heavily or moving container plants indoors, as it has no cold hardiness. All parts of the plant are toxic if ingested; plant away from children's play areas and wash hands after pruning.

planting.note: Set out rooted cuttings after frost in rich, well-drained soil in full sun to partial shade; a heavy, regular feeding program produces the largest and most abundant blooms.

directions: 'Grand Marnier' is one of the most popular Southern garden Brugmansia, prized for its very large, double, softly ruffled apricot-to-peach trumpets that deepen in tone as they age and hang in generous clusters. Like other angel's trumpets it blooms most heavily with heavy feeding, consistent moisture, and warm temperatures, releasing its strongest sweet fragrance after dusk. It has no frost tolerance, so cut back and mulch heavily where winters freeze, or overwinter containers in a protected spot. All parts of the plant are toxic if ingested; site away from children and pets and wash hands after pruning.

planting.note: Set out rooted cuttings after frost in fertile, moist, well-drained soil in partial shade to full sun; a vigorous grower that fills out quickly with regular feeding.

directions: 'Cypress Gardens', named for the Florida attraction where it was popularized, bears large, fully double, pure white pendant trumpets that carry the genus's characteristic heavy, sweet fragrance most strongly in the evening. It is a fast, vigorous grower typical of angel's trumpets and rewards regular feeding and consistent moisture with near-continuous warm-season bloom. It has no cold tolerance, so mulch heavily after cutting back or move container plants to a protected space before frost. All parts of the plant are toxic if ingested; plant away from children's play areas and wash hands after handling.
